WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        AVG(CAST(double AS REAL)) AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason
    WHERE double IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_indices AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_id,
        p.bats,
        pa.avg_doubles,
        pa.avg_doubles / AVG(pa.avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx
    FROM player_averages pa
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
),
hand_averages AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        avg_doubles,
        idx,
        idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap
    FROM player_indices
)
SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, gap
FROM hand_averages
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
